title: I made a first_person gold mining game (Deep Claim). It is available on itch.io to play. it still needs polishing but i work on it everyday
author: NoBox1552
selftext:
I've been working on Deep Claim, a first-person incremental about gold mining, and it's now playable on [itch.io](http://itch.io/)

The loop:

\- You start at a camp with nothing but a frying pan. Swirl, wash and pick out every fleck by hand.

\- Sell your gold, buy better pans, shovels, buckets and sluices.

\- Open the old mine: swing a pickaxe, crush ore in a mortar, smelt it into bars.

\- Automate it with drills, carts, conveyors, trommels and better sluices until the gold runs itself.

\- Then dive into the flooded cave for what's down there.

There's also fishing from a boat, a cabin you can fix up, and a riverside casino if you want to gamble some of your gold away.

It's early access and I'm working on it almost every day, so I'd really like to hear what you think of the pacing. Where did it feel slow, where did it click, and what upgrade did you want that wasn't there? Any feed back would be appreciated

Play it here: [https://ttrogdor.itch.io/deep-claim](https://ttrogdor.itch.io/deep-claim)

Windows only for now. Thanks for checking it out!

i did what i could by my self but i do not know enough to make a game without Ai assistance. i made some sound, some models but most are AI. Would still like your help making this a fun game!
